description: Defines the HostCache class and related structures for DNS hostname caching within the net namespace, including key management, cache entries, and cache operations.

classes.name: HostCache
classes.description: A cache for hostname resolution results, mapping hostnames to their resolved IP addresses and related metadata.

classes.name: HostCache::Key
classes.description: Represents a key in the cache, including hostname, DNS query type, resolver flags, source, and security info.

classes.name: HostCache::Entry
classes.description: Represents a cached DNS resolution result, including IP addresses, errors, TTL, and metadata.

classes.name: HostCache::EntryStaleness
classes.description: Indicates how stale a cache entry is, including expiration and network change info.

classes.name: HostCache::PersistenceDelegate
classes.description: Interface for persistent storage interactions for the cache.

methods.name: HostCache::Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves a valid cache entry for a given key at a specific time.

methods.name: HostCache::Set
methods.description: Stores or updates a cache entry for a given key.

methods.name: HostCache::Invalidate
methods.description: Marks all cache entries as stale due to network change.
